shortDescription: Publish changes from a repository available on the execution node to a distant location

options.name: include
options.description: A list of files to include (add) in the commit

options.name: open_browser
options.description: Open the default browser to the pull-request page

options.name: remove
options.description: Remove the local copy of the repository if the push is successful

options.name: ssh_key_content
options.description: The content of the SSH private key for authentication with git. Ideal for use with Ansible Vault or other secret management systems. Used only for SSH-based repository URLs.

options.name: ssh_key_file
options.description: Path to the SSH private key file to use for authentication with git. Used only for SSH-based repository URLs (e.g., git@github.com:...).

options.name: tag
options.description: Specify the tag details associated with the commit.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds for each command issued

options.name: token
options.description:
The token to use to authenticate to the origin repository If provided, an 'http.extraheader' will be added to the commands interacting with the origin repository
 Will only be used for https based connections

options.name: user
options.description: Details for the user to be used for the commit Will only be used if not already configured
